recipes.notes: Generated by cmd/new-card on 2026-10-04 from runtime pack yukon-native-qwen38-abliterated-mtp-20261004 revision 2. Candidate only. One live local_functional receipt passes gui_launch, openai_api and the chat capability; every other capability and validation check is not_tested. No speed claim or recommendation is made. The pack is display data only: this generator did not verify its signature, expiry, platforms or pins. The engine pins this checkpoint by target manifest SHA-256 2a8ae437e720504d5d27d8bf2c5bba29801002383c618a1dadb92befcac1b224, passed as --target-manifest. context_tokens is the pack profile setting, not a tested serving limit. min_unified_memory_gib is the pack profile minimum. Sampling follows the amesh-yukon-native engine contract: greedy with explicit temperature 0; omitted or stochastic temperature is rejected. Upstream generation_config.json sets do_sample=true, temperature=1, top_p=0.95, top_k=20; these are upstream defaults only. Upstream license: apache-2.0. Upstream base model: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B. Upstream pipeline tag: image-text-to-text. The target manifest's nine entries match the corresponding target.files paths, SHA-256 hashes and sizes; the card author checked this. This third-party checkpoint has its refusal behavior removed (abliterated); it is not the upstream Qwen release.

evidence.scope: One owned web GUI Start and Confirm of signed pack revision 2 on a remote Mac, then two non-streaming Chat Completions requests
evidence.notes: Web GUI profile selection, Mesh, Start and Confirm launched profile yukon-qwen3_8-27b-abliterated-mtp-4bit from signed pack revision 2 (SHA-256 c17863b13a86b0277e34853568f4cc6041a69aaa6364999bbbb43b2d4e43b47a) with engine SHA-256 33e0bbfe7119ce197b6caebdbe35e3048c6721d03d5a1f5f055910cd84364c7b. The helper reported the exact profile live with 65,536 context tokens. Weights came from the local cache; the launch reached ready 39 seconds after start (16:43:30Z to 16:44:09Z) on the first readiness attempt. A temperature-0 chat completion returned READY with finish_reason stop and usage of 17 prompt and 1 completion tokens. A second chat completion returned a coherent two-sentence Rayleigh scattering answer with 60 completion tokens; the receipt does not record its sampling settings. Native MTP counters for that request: 22 cycles, 39 accepted and 24 rejected drafts, 61 committed and 60 completion tokens, 1,122 ms generation time. These are execution counters from one request, not a speed measurement, comparison or recommendation. Streaming, usage accounting, output limits, cancellation, tools, thinking, private-mesh routing and output fidelity were not tested. The receipt does not record chip, memory or OS version.
